messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.

- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02-3: Cinder has moved to the third floor.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-06-02] standup/cinder/2025-06-02: Cinder adopted trunk-based development.
- [2025-12-15] standup/cinder/2025-12-15: Team change: Diego leaves team Cinder and joins team Ember, effective today. With Diego moving on, Yuki is on call for the Cinder team from today.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29: Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-08-20] standup/cinder/2025-08-20: Decision: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, because feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical. Cinder noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: Atlas owns billing-api. Atlas looks after the flags service.
- [2025-01-08] standup/cinder/2025-01-08: For the org chart: Yuki and Diego are on team Cinder.
- [2025-09-15] standup/cinder/2025-09-15: Reminder that the catalog service depends on image-resizer.
- [2025-11-19] handover/2025-11-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: Team Dune owns the reporting service.
- [2025-02-13] handover/2025-02-13-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the flags service moves from team Atlas to the Cinder team. Priya walked Diego through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-05-28] standup/cinder/2026-05-28: Yuki Tanaka still has the Cinder pager.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29-2: The Cinder team noticed that search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-16] standup/cinder/2025-01-16: Diego Alvarez takes the first the Cinder team on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02: Yuki picked up the Cinder on-call shift from Diego today.
- [2026-05-01] standup/cinder/2026-05-01: From today the ledger service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: Team Ember owns the job scheduler.
- [2026-01-29] handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the feature flag service moves from Cinder to team Dune. Yuki walked Farah Haddad through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-06-13] standup/cinder/2025-06-13: Diego Alvarez has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-reporting: Ownership change: the reports pipeline now sits with team Ember. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2: The catalog deploy window: on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays.
- [2025-11-25] standup/cinder/2025-11-25: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: The event bus is a the Boreal team service. The Boreal team owns notifier.
- [2025-03-27] standup/cinder/2025-03-27: Rotation day for Cinder: Yuki hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-07-22] standup/cinder/2025-07-22: Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Yuki Tanaka carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-04-10] standup/ember/2025-04-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.
- [2026-04-29] handover/2026-04-29-ledger: Cinder is taking over the ledger from team Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-02-17] standup/cinder/2025-02-17: Reminder from the Cinder team: page Yuki Tanaka for anything this cycle, not Diego.

Question: Which services does Cinder own now?

message.content: The product catalog, the notifier, and the ledger service.
